psygun.label: Shot
psygun.line: Clears the three rows through a cell: gems, junk and embers

dreamvane.label: Vein
dreamvane.line: Clears every gem of one colour on your half

soulbrush.label: Paint
soulbrush.line: Turns the 3 x 3 round a gem to that gem's colour

sondelass.label: Grab
sondelass.line: Hooks the junk out of a 5 x 5 and throws it across

crucibelle.label: Tune
crucibelle.line: One colour clears at any 3 touching, this turn and your next

lockheart.label: Hold
lockheart.line: Throws the junk about to land on you straight back

veritome.label: Read
veritome.line: Two action points back, and the fog lifts for three turns
